text:
anya: Heads up — planning to shift prod traffic to rm-v2-quant during tonight's 22:00 UTC change window. Need ops + oncall signoff.
kevin: What's the fallback ordering? want to avoid quality cliffs on fallback.
sam: Proposing fallback order: rm-v2-quant -> rm-v2-fp16 -> rm-v1-quant -> rm-legacy. rm-v1 shows noticeable quality drop on our semantic tests.
maria: Do we have perf numbers at 2048 context? p50 / p95?
sam: Quick numbers from local perf run (2048, batch=1):
```
p50: 68ms token
p95: 210ms token
throughput @80rps steady, no OOMs
```
leah-eng: I ran an 80rps soak earlier, autoscaler behaved, KV cache warmed in ~6min, no kernel OOMs.
anya: Preflight checklist I'm proposing: canary 3% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with ~15min observation per step. Rollback triggers: error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency regression >30% vs baseline.
kevin: We should pin the catalog variant during the canary. Suggest pin to `rm-v2-quant@v20260320-rc1`. That avoids accidental drift.
sam: Agreed. Also adding a fallback-priority map to the catalog entry (pushed as part of the pin). Example snippet: `fallbacks: ["rm-v2-fp16", "rm-v1-quant", "rm-legacy"]`.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started — 3% traffic -> rm-v2-quant (catalog:v20260320-rc1).
oncall-bot: oncall-bot: monitoring rule active — alert if error rate >0.5% for 5m or p95 latency increases >30%.
maria: Dashboards: https://console.redwood/infer/dashboards/model-rollouts/ (watching request errors, p95, tokencost).
kevin: If we need to rollback, procedure? immediate pin to previous catalog v20260319 + warmup job?
anya: Rollback plan: abort rollout, pin catalog to `v20260319`, run a short warm-up (3 nodes, 2 minutes), confirm latency stabilizes. We'll post to status and open a follow-up incident if customers impacted.
leah-eng: I'll be watching GPU driver logs and kernel failures during promotion. If I see any OOM/driver restarts I'll trigger rollback.
sam: Note: quantized variant had small eval-quality regressions on the "agent-instruction" test family; we have a regression threshold set. If eval quality drop >1% we trigger rollback too.
maria: :thumbsup: good to me.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary at 3% stable for 18m — promoting to 10%.
anya: I can't be at the keyboard for the 50% step. Kevin, can you lead the 10->50->100 sequence?
kevin: On it. I'll run the checklist and call the 50% swap once dashboards look clean.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promoted to 100% — rollout complete. catalog now points to v20260320-rc1 for rm-v2.
sam: Great. Follow-ups: I'll draft release notes with fallback mapping, perf summary, and the eval regression status. Will open PR in release-notes repo.
maria: Leave a 24h watch and lock the model pin for 48h. Tagging product for visibility.
anya: Thanks everyone — smooth run. Closing thread. :party_parrot:
